# Business Goal Linkage

Every AI initiative ties to one or more named business goals. This document defines the goals per tenant and maps each initiative to its primary goal.

This is what makes the demo make sense — without business goal context, AI initiatives are just technology purchases. With it, they're investments in a thesis.

---

## APEX RETAIL · 4 named business goals

### AR-GOAL-01 · Defend margin amid value-player pressure
Strategic context: discount and value retailers eating share. Apex's traditional mid-market position squeezed.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** AR-04 (Joule for Merch), AR-05 (Demand Forecasting)

### AR-GOAL-02 · Improve cost-to-serve while protecting CX
Strategic context: contact center costs growing faster than revenue. Customer expectations rising on response time.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** AR-03 (Autonomous CX Agent ⭐), AR-01 (Store Associate Copilot)

### AR-GOAL-03 · Accelerate digital growth (revenue per session)
Strategic context: digital channel growing 18% YoY but revenue per session below industry leaders. Personalization gap.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** AR-07 (Personalization Engine v3), AR-02 (GitHub Copilot — enables the engineering velocity)

### AR-GOAL-04 · Build AI capability foundation
Strategic context: ad-hoc AI adoption creating cost and governance risk. Need a platform layer.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** AR-06 (AI Cost Attribution Platform)

---

## FIRST CAPITAL FINANCIAL · 4 named business goals

### FCF-GOAL-01 · Defend NIM through better risk-adjusted pricing
Strategic context: NIM compression accelerating (14bp/quarter, 3 consecutive quarters). Need to price better, not chase volume.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** FCF-04 (Credit Decisioning Modernization ⭐)

### FCF-GOAL-02 · Achieve regulatory posture for AI
Strategic context: SR 11-7 + FFIEC AI guidance + OCC bulletins tightening. Must demonstrate model risk maturity to examiners.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** FCF-07 (Model Risk Governance ⭐)

### FCF-GOAL-03 · Reduce loss + protect customer experience
Strategic context: fraud rising in digital channels. False positives damaging customer experience.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** FCF-05 (Fraud Detection Refresh)

### FCF-GOAL-04 · Productivity uplift in middle/back office
Strategic context: cost-to-income ratio above peer median. Need productivity gains.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** FCF-01 (M365 Copilot), FCF-02 (AI-Assisted Code Review), FCF-03 (Advisor Decision-Support), FCF-06 (Conversational Banking)

---

## MERIDIAN HEALTH · 4 named business goals

### MH-GOAL-01 · Address physician burnout · improve retention
Strategic context: physician shortage acute. Burnout-driven attrition costing $400K-$1.2M per departing physician. Documentation burden cited as #1 driver.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** MH-01 (Clinical Documentation Copilot ⭐)

### MH-GOAL-02 · Restore margin · accelerate financial recovery
Strategic context: post-COVID financial recovery slow. Operating margin still below pre-2020. Revenue cycle leakage a major lever.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** MH-04 (Epic AI for Revenue Cycle ⭐), MH-06 (Joule for Finance)

### MH-GOAL-03 · Improve clinical outcomes · reduce avoidable readmissions
Strategic context: value-based care contracts make readmissions a direct financial liability. Quality metrics also tied to reimbursement.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** MH-05 (Clinical Risk Stratification ML)

### MH-GOAL-04 · Build safe AI capability foundation
Strategic context: HIPAA + emerging AI regulation + clinical safety bar means AI rollouts can't move fast without governance. Foundation prevents future debt.
**Initiatives serving this goal:** MH-07 (Model Governance & FinOps Platform), MH-02 (Vibe Coding Rollout — gated on governance), MH-03 (Autonomous Helpdesk — gated on governance)

---

## Why this linkage matters

When a CXO opens Tower or Intelligence, they should see initiatives **organized by business goal**, not by technology category. The category taxonomy is for the platform's internal accounting; the business goal is what the CXO recognizes.

The Home → AI Initiatives Registry view should default to **"By Business Goal"** view, with toggle to **"By Category"** view available.

---

## Aligned-callout justifications

The 6 starred ⭐ initiatives are the ones AbarVa surfaces as the **strategic anchors** for each tenant — the ones the platform is most opinionated about being right.

| ⭐ Initiative | Tenant | Why it's the anchor |
|---|---|---|
| AR-03 Autonomous CX Agent | Apex | Largest single initiative tied to AR-GOAL-02 (cost-to-serve) — material if it succeeds, material if it doesn't |
| AR-05 Demand Forecasting | Apex | Strongest measured ROI in portfolio · proof-point for AI investment thesis |
| FCF-04 Credit Decisioning | FCF | Largest initiative · single biggest lever for NIM defense thesis |
| FCF-07 Model Risk Governance | FCF | Blocks 4 other initiatives · regulatory urgency rising |
| MH-01 Clinical Documentation | Meridian | #1 board-level metric (physician satisfaction) · proven impact |
| MH-04 Epic AI Revenue Cycle | Meridian | Direct margin recovery lever · single largest non-platform investment |

These are the initiatives Atlas / Sentinel / Steward should foreground in their synthesis. They're also the ones most likely to become Strategic Moves (or already are).
